from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
from importlib.util import module_from_spec, spec_from_file_location
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest

from tools import source_case_runner as runner
from tools.source_case_receipt import encode_source_receipt


def fast_tool():
    path = Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/invest-skills/tools/pre_push_gate.py')
    spec = spec_from_file_location('independent_root_fast', path)
    module = module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_complete_unseen_record_retains_all_large_evidence_and_unknowns():
    record = {'status': 'SOURCE_RETURNED', 'source_processing_complete': False,
              'runtime_unchanged': None, 'required_units': [{'unit_id': 'u-x', 'represented': False}],
              'source_excerpt_units': [{'unit_id': 'u-x', 'raw_text': '精确原文🙂' * 130000}],
              'optional_trace': [{'exact': str(i) + 'x'*5000} for i in range(100)]}
    before = deepcopy(record)
    data = runner.encode_receipt(record)
    assert len(data) > 1000000 and json.loads(data) == before == record
    assert json.loads(encode_source_receipt(record)) == before


def test_unseen_deep_tree_and_cycle_are_not_confused():
    sections = [{'section_id':str(i), 'parent_id':str(i+1) if i < 172 else None,
                 'heading_unit_ids':['h'+str(i)],'body_unit_ids':['target'] if i==0 else []} for i in range(173)]
    source = {'sections':sections}
    oracles = [{'oracle_id':'independent','original_support_unit_ids':['target']}]
    originals = {uid:object() for uid in ['target',*['h'+str(i) for i in range(173)]]}
    rows,_=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracles,source,originals)
    assert rows[0]['support_units'][0]['section_paths'][0]['ancestry_path_complete'] is True
    assert len(rows[0]['support_units'][0]['ancestor_heading_unit_ids']) == 173
    sections[-1]['parent_id']='7'
    rows,_=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracles,source,originals)
    assert rows[0]['support_units'][0]['section_paths'][0]['ancestry_path_complete'] is False


def test_context_proof_overlap_keeps_roles_without_forging_actor_pass():
    structure = {'sections':[{'section_id':'a','parent_id':None,'heading_unit_ids':['heading'],'body_unit_ids':['target']}],
        'semantic_units':[{'required_context_by_unit_id':{'target':['both','qualifier']},
            'required_source_unit_ids_by_unit_id':{'target':['both','proof-only']}}],
        'diagnostics':[{'code':'SOURCE_SCOPE_UNPROVEN','unit_ids':['target']} ]}
    before=deepcopy(structure)
    oracle=[{'oracle_id':'roles','original_support_unit_ids':['target'],
             'original_forbidden_context_unit_ids':['proof-only','both','heading']}]
    rows,ids=runner.structure_context_checkpoints(oracle,structure,{'target':object()})
    row=rows[0]['support_units'][0]
    assert row['forbidden_context_ids_observed']==['both','heading']
    assert row['semantic_context_unit_ids']==['both','qualifier']
    assert row['physical_source_proof_unit_ids']==['both','proof-only']
    assert row['unavailable_context_unit_ids']==sorted(ids)
    assert rows[0]['status']=='STRUCTURE_OBSERVED_NO_ACTOR_INFERENCE'
    assert row['source_diagnostics'] and structure==before


def test_real_atomic_io_failure_keeps_previous_checkpoint(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    path=tmp_path/'current.json';owned={}
    runner.atomic_owned_write(path,b'previous',owned,root_dir=tmp_path)
    def unavailable(fd):raise OSError('synthetic fsync unavailable')
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner.os,'fsync',unavailable)
    with pytest.raises(OSError):runner.atomic_owned_write(path,b'new',owned,root_dir=tmp_path)
    assert path.read_bytes()==b'previous' and owned[path.resolve()]==sha256(b'previous').hexdigest()
    assert not list(tmp_path.glob('*.writing-*'))


def test_worker_encoding_failure_preserves_unknown_state_and_real_checkpoint(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    case=tmp_path/'cases.json';output=tmp_path/'result.json'
    case.write_text(json.dumps({'cases':[{'case_id':'unique','request':{'source_ref':{'source_id':'synthetic'}}}]}),encoding='utf-8')
    class Unknown:
        def __repr__(self):raise AssertionError('no arbitrary repr')
    record={'case_id':'unique','status':'SOURCE_RETURNED','required_units':[{'unit_id':'u','represented':False}],
            'database_unchanged':None,'original_files_unchanged':False,'runtime_unchanged':True,'optional':Unknown()}
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner,'execute',lambda *args,**kwargs:record)
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys,'argv',['observer','--worker','--manifest',str(case),'--case','unique','--output',str(output)])
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as caught:runner.main()
    assert caught.value.code==2
    saved=json.loads(output.read_bytes());checkpoint=json.loads(output.with_suffix('.json.checkpoint.json').read_bytes())
    assert saved['status']=='OBSERVATION_INCOMPLETE' and saved['source_status']=='SOURCE_RETURNED'
    assert checkpoint['database_unchanged'] is None and checkpoint['original_files_unchanged'] is False
    assert checkpoint['required_checkpoints'][0]['represented'] is False


def test_commit_checks_staged_content_not_a_different_worktree_version(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    repo=tmp_path/'git';repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',str(repo)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    path=repo/'changed.py';path.write_text('def staged_invalid(:\n',encoding='utf-8')
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'add','changed.py'],check=True,capture_output=True)
    path.write_text('valid_worktree = True\n',encoding='utf-8')
    staged=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'show',':changed.py'],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout
    assert staged==b'def staged_invalid(:\n'
    tool=fast_tool();monkeypatch.setattr(tool,'PROJECT_ROOT',repo)
    calls=[]
    monkeypatch.setattr(tool,'_run',lambda *args,**kwargs:calls.append(args) or 0)
    code=tool.main(['--commit'])
    assert code!=0, 'Invalid index bytes must not be certified from a valid worktree version'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('exit_code',[0,23])
def test_actual_fast_runner_does_not_veto_large_logs_or_hide_real_exit(exit_code,capsys):
    tool=fast_tool()
    command=[sys.executable,'-B','-c',"import sys;sys.stdout.write('x'*80000+'final-marker');sys.exit("+str(exit_code)+")"]
    assert tool._run(command,'independent noisy child')==exit_code
    printed=capsys.readouterr().out
    assert 'final-marker' in printed and len(printed)<17000

from importlib.util import module_from_spec, spec_from_file_location
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import pytest


def load_tool():
    path=Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/invest-skills/tools/pre_push_gate.py')
    spec=spec_from_file_location('independent_index_r2',path)
    module=module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


@pytest.mark.parametrize('staged,worktree,expected',[
    ('valid_index = True\n','def broken_worktree(:\n',0),
    ('answer = unresolved_symbol\n','answer = 42\n',1),
])
def test_real_ruff_uses_index_and_preserves_index_worktree_and_config(tmp_path,monkeypatch,staged,worktree,expected):
    repo=tmp_path/'仓 库';repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',str(repo)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    path=repo/'folder'/'例.py';path.parent.mkdir();path.write_text(staged,encoding='utf-8')
    (repo/'pyproject.toml').write_text('[tool.ruff.lint]\nselect=["F821"]\n',encoding='utf-8')
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'add','folder/例.py'],check=True,capture_output=True)
    index=(repo/'.git/index').read_bytes();path.write_text(worktree,encoding='utf-8')
    tool=load_tool();monkeypatch.setattr(tool,'PROJECT_ROOT',repo)
    temp=Path(__file__).parent/'t';before=set(temp.glob('invest-staged-*'))
    assert tool.main(['--commit'])==expected
    assert path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==worktree and (repo/'.git/index').read_bytes()==index
    assert tool._staged_bytes(path)==staged.encode()
    assert set(temp.glob('invest-staged-*'))==before
